Suzanne — thanks, and this is doable. Laura (SE) will lead the technical walkthrough; I will run the commercial portion and ensure procurement joins the tail. Sergio will bring the integration checklist.

Proposal: rotate across three candidate slots (we can alternate for week-to-week calls so no one is always outside business hours). All times list local conversions (PT / CET / JST) and are ~60 minutes including Q&A:

Option 1 — APAC-friendly (we run at APAC business hours):
- 23:00 PDT / 08:00 CET (next day) / 16:00 JST — works if APAC needs daytime presence.

Option 2 — EMEA-friendly (middle ground):
- 14:00 PDT / 23:00 CET / 07:00 JST (next day) — early for APAC, late for EU; not ideal but doable infrequently.

Option 3 — US-friendly (rotates burden to EU/APAC):
- 10:00 PDT / 19:00 CET / 03:00 JST (next day) — best for US overlap with EU evenings.

My recommendation is to pick Option 1 for the kickoff (keeps APAC in day), then rotate to Option 3 for the follow-up so the US team gets a reasonable hour. If you prefer a single rotation schedule for the pilot week, we can do: Week A = Option 1, Week B = Option 3, Week C = Option 2.

Attached: redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf (agenda + roles) and network-topology-reference.xlsx (what to have available).

If these look good, I can publish a pick-two poll (or share a Calendly multi-slot) and draft a mutual action plan.

Best,
